brief:
A bill pending in Congress aims to dismantle UNRWA, the United Nations agency that provides services to Palestinian refugees across the Middle East, Mondoweiss reported. The legislation is described as part of a broader, coordinated campaign to eliminate pathways to justice for Palestinian refugees and to permanently resolve the refugee question by foreclosing claims tied to displacement and return.

Palestinian activists and analysts characterize the measure as an existential threat to refugee populations and their legal standing. The push to eliminate UNRWA represents an attempt to erase Palestinian refugee grievances and block assertion of the right of return before shifting geopolitical circumstances create new openings for Palestinian claims.
dek: A bill in Congress aims to dismantle UNRWA, the UN agency for Palestinian refugees. It is part of a coordinated campaign to eliminate the possibility of justice for Palestinian refugees. Palestinians must resist before it's too late.
title: Congress bill targets UNRWA and Palestinian refugee rights
